_about: What finishing a faction arc awards (Ryan, Oct 26: cosmetic reward plus gameplay unlock). Ids (medal, paint, unlock_variant) stay unchanged for save compatibility. Text updated to space-first US English and aligned with STORY_BEAT3.

voidsworn.arc: The Oath at the Hollow Sun

medal.d: Burn out the siphon relay at the Hollow Sun to finish the Sunward Crusade story.

voidsworn.title: Breaker of the Siphon

paint.pattern: Frost-white armor plate over matte black iron trim, glowing ember radiator fins, and chalked crew names along the flanks.

medal.d: Secure the Hollow Sun orbital perimeter to finish the Meridian Directorate story.

paint.pattern: Charcoal stealth hull with silver wedge trim and a single white stripe commemorating the column that survived.

medal.d: Claim R-5 Rook from the wreck field to finish the Ashfall Hullbreakers story.

paint.pattern: Soot-black hull riveted over with mismatched trophy plates from all six factions and twin crimson running lights along the flanks.

medal.d: Swallow the surviving Lattice cores at the Hollow Sun to finish the Chorus story.

paint.pattern: Dark scorched carapace veined with slow-pulsing gold thermal channels.

medal.d: Recover the Lattice's last primary lens to finish the Glasswrights story.

paint.pattern: Smoked crystal with pearlescent bevels, pale violet optical vanes, and ancestor lineages etched along the forward spine.

medal.d: Bring the remaining cores home to Ardent's rim to finish Eclipse's story.

paint.pattern: Violet-black sunshade plates inlaid with pale gold, shifting the corona glow from cold violet to remembered sunlight.
